items.author: onlyretrofans.com
items.context: I don't remember a whole lot about my old games, I do remember they were written in BASIC - I *think* my cousin might have done the tape art, in which case it would have been pretty good. If not then i'd have done it - and it wouldn't be
items.text: Writing games in BASIC and saving them to tape, with your own cassette art, is about as hands-on as retro gets.

items.author: rawrparty.bsky.social
items.context: I really enjoyed getting to play some classic games on the GameCube and N64 from my childhood, even if I was beaten by friends I was with. I didn’t get in the ball pit this year or really play with legos which I’m a lil sad about but just means I need to put it on the list for next time 2/12
items.text: Classic GameCube and N64 games with friends sounds like the best kind of nostalgia, losing included.
